A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, with matching main sections and Appendices A–H. Text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison; the pagination changes from 52 to 53 pages.

before.justification: v5 reports original continual-learning experiments, including accuracy, forgetting, label-release sensitivity, and aggregation-rule comparisons in Section 6 and Appendices D–F.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experiments and their numerical results in Section 6 and Appendices D–F.

M1.justification: Both retain the same private label-release and public-label alternatives, noisy cumulative-feature Cosine Classifier, and FiLM/DP-SGD PEFT Ensemble. Added explanations and notation corrections do not change their procedures.

E1.justification: Both use ImageNet-21K pretraining and evaluate Split-CIFAR-100, Split-ImageNet-R, and 5-Datasets. Disjoint, blurry-task, enlarged-label-space, and domain-shift scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the enhanced Desai et al. (2021), Label Oracle, Base Dataset, Naive, and Non-CL baselines. Appendix D.2 also retains the ArgMax, Median, and Entropy aggregation comparison.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix D retain the data splits, model configurations, accuracy/forgetting metrics, privacy budgets, and 40-epoch/20-trial tuning settings. Section 7's new method-selection advice does not report a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The privacy-budget split, public-label-space size, blurriness, aggregation-rule, and domain-shift analyses are unchanged. The expanded discussion introduces interpretations without additional experimental analyses.

E5.justification: Both retain the same repeat counts, task-order permutations, median and order-statistic reporting, min/max error bars, and appendix mean/standard-deviation tables. No uncertainty-reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: The experimental figures and Tables A3–A10 retain their results and missing entries. For example, Table A3 reports the same Release Labels accuracies: 78.4% for Cosine Classifier on CIFAR-100 at epsilon 1 and 64.0% for PEFT Ensemble on ImageNet-R at epsilon 8.

T1.justification: Appendix C.3 removes v5's erroneous statement that the constraint in Eq. (A71) is trivial, correcting a localized proof argument. The bound and Theorem C.3 remain unchanged. The expanded Proposition 4.2 sketch restates reasoning already present in Appendix C.2.

C1.justification: The abstract and central contributions remain unchanged. The introduction reorganizes two contribution bullets into three; the broader applicability to classification beyond continual learning was already explicitly stated in v5.

C2.justification: Section 7 adds conditions involving data size, embedding separation, and blurriness for choosing methods, explains private fine-tuning instability, and discusses privacy accounting for validation-based selection. Figure 1 is explicitly identified as conceptual, and Appendix C.3 clarifies that a bound requiring delta at least 1 gives a vacuous guarantee.

D1.justification: Section 8 changes the documented code repository from PROBIC/private-continual-learning to TrustworthyMLHelsinki/dp-continual-learning. Implementation, hyperparameter, hardware, and dataset-version disclosures otherwise remain substantively unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and positioning relative to prior privacy and continual-learning research remain unchanged. An added URL for the existing notMNIST reference and bibliographic capitalization corrections do not introduce new cited works.

P1.justification: v6 rewrites the contribution list and method recommendations, expands explanations in Sections 4.3 and 6, corrects grammar and typos, and updates author information. The overall section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: v6 adds journal headers, revises the author layout, changes float placement, and clarifies Figure 1's caption. Figure 4 moves from page 11 to page 12. The same scientific figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v6 improves precision through the localized proof correction, the qualification of Theorem C.3's guarantee, and clearer identification of Figure 1 as conceptual. More conditional method-selection guidance also improves usability. These are limited gains: the methods, experimental coverage, and reported results remain unchanged.
